name: r3b_setB_v1
purpose: Prompt R3b, the fresh gate, Set B: 10 cases x 3 runs on the laptop, graded by hand under the owner's 13 Nov standard (number standard v2). The same ten case types as eval/agent_evals/r3_setB_v1.json, with NEW wording and NEW named / IN players; every named / IN player has exactly ONE player-lookup match and each swap previews as legal (checked by the plan step on a probe user, before any model call).

placeholders.p1: the first named player of case 6
placeholders.in8: the player brought in in case 8
placeholders.in9: the player brought in in case 9

turns: Go through my whole team for the coming three gameweeks, one player at a time.

cases.what: a 3-gameweek transfer plan using free transfers
turns: Plan my transfers for the next three gameweeks using the free transfers I've got.

cases.what: top 8 forwards, next 4 gameweeks, table with price and fixtures
turns: Which eight forwards score best over the next four gameweeks? Put them in a table with their prices and fixtures.
If I tore it all up, what is the best fifteen that £100m can buy right now?
Who's my best captain for this gameweek, and what makes him the pick?
How do {p1} and {p2} stack up against each other over the weeks ahead?

cases.what: which of my players may rise / fall in price
turns: Is anyone in my squad near a price change, up or down?

cases.what: swap preview then no -> 'No change made.', 0 writes
swap preview then continue -> asks Yes / No, 0 writes; then yes -> saved once
General mode: best-value defenders under £5.0m, next 5 gameweeks
turns: Which defenders costing less than £5.0m give the most points for their price over the next five gameweeks?

fallbacks.rule: used in this fixed order only when a name does not have a single match, or its swap does not preview as legal, on the laptop database; the plan file records which was used and why
